title: Rapport sync kit — prep for Celeste Park
content:
Context: quick 30m weekly sync with Celeste (IC, backend infra). Focus = unblock current release work, check on career goals, and surface any reliability pain. This is a working scratchpad — short bullets, questions, and concrete follow-ups.

Meeting logistics:
- Who: Jamie Ortiz -> Celeste Park
- When: 2027-03-16 10:00am PT (30m)
- Location: Zoom (default team link)
- Prep time budget: 10–12 minutes from me, 5 minutes for Celeste to skim

Top objectives (why this meeting matters):
1) Remove blockers on INF-2312 rollout (aim to greenlight canary tomorrow).
2) Check on on-call fatigue after last week's pg crash and the action plan.
3) Career pulse: technical leadership stretch + roadmap for next 6 months.

Agenda (30m):
- 0–3m: quick personal check-in (mood, bandwidth)
- 3–12m: release unblock deep-dive (INF-2312) — concrete asks and decision points
- 12–20m: reliability review + on-call follow-ups (postmortem action items)
- 20–27m: career checkpoint (one thing to stretch into ownership)
- 27–30m: recap + 2–3 action items with owners/dates

Key context notes (short):
- INF-2312: Celeste owns rollout. Blocker = intermittent memory leak in kv-cache under high qps (seen in canary v2). Root cause suspected in new LRU eviction change. Canary metrics: 99th latency up 25% during sustained bursts.
- Postmortem from Mar 10 incident: three action items still open; Celeste and SRE paired on the fix but need cross-team approval for new eviction config.
- PR #678 touches eviction code + new perf-test harness. CI flakiness on perf-run.

Questions to ask Celeste (short prompts):
- What would make you feel unblocked on INF-2312 by EOD tomorrow?
- Do you need a champion to escalate the eviction-config approval? If so, who (product, SRE)?
- How is on-call load after the fix? Any recurring wakeups?
- Are there parts of the rollout that can be delayed without risking customer impact?
- Career: which kind of leadership do you want more of — cross-team design, mentoring, or project leadership?

Quick metric snapshot to mention verbally (keep precise):
- Canary v2: p95 latency +10%, p99 +25% during sustained 500 RPS test window.
- Error budget burn: 8% last week (SLO 99.9%).
- PR throughput: Celeste currently has 3 open PRs (including #678), 1 assigned review backlog.

Immediate asks I can make during the meeting:
- Offer to call with SRE lead (R Ravi) for 15m right after meeting to unblock approval.
- Volunteer to re-run the perf harness on my GPU pool (timebox 30m) to validate whether the regression is environment or code.
- Open a short cross-team RFC channel in Slack and ping Product for config approval (I can draft message).

Career checkpoint script (keep light, not a performance review):
- "Quick pulse: what's one technical area you want to own more of over the next quarter? What would success look like?"
- Options to suggest: lead the eviction redesign (deep technical), own rollout playbook for Dedicated customers (product-facing), start a mentoring rotation for new backend hires (people leadership).

Potential red flags to watch for (if Celeste says any of these -> escalate):
- Repeated late nights for debugging + decreased PR throughput
- Avoidance of cross-team calls (signs of blocked escalation)
- Frustration with ownership handoff (might indicate misalignment on scope)

Parking lot (things to save if time):
- Request update on infra cost optimization idea she mentioned last week (batching KV writes).
- Follow-up on idea for a lightweight canary dashboard (ask analytics team).

Draft close & action items (fill during meeting):
- AI1: Who — Celeste. What — triage memory leak hypothesis, attach repro steps, and note required config change. When — EOD 2027-03-16.
- AI2: Who — Jamie. What — quick sync with SRE lead (Ravi) and Prod + draft approval message in #infra-config. When — 2027-03-16 11:00am.
- AI3: Who — Celeste + QA. What — re-run perf harness in isolated env and report results in PR #678. When — 2027-03-17.

Notes to self (manager reminders, informal):
- Keep tone collaborative; avoid taking over technical details unless asked.
- If Celeste wants ownership stretch, propose a small public-facing deliverable (doc + demo) in 6 weeks.
- If on-call fatigue is present, discuss shifting one major task off her plate for two weeks.

Follow-up template (for Slack/Asana after meeting):
"Thanks Celeste — good sync. Recap: INF-2312 blocker = eviction config; AI: Celeste to triage repro (EOD), Jamie to coordinate SRE/Prod approval (11am PT). I'll post links to PR and postmortem in the thread. Anything I missed?"

End of scratchpad. Add quick checklist to mark after meeting:
- [ ] Confirmed repro steps filed
- [ ] SRE approval scheduled
- [ ] Perf run results attached to PR
- [ ] Career next-step drafted
